title: Vitamin-C–RDW coupling does not establish improved cross-cycle prediction of C-reactive protein
abstract: In separately sampled NHANES cycles, adding (log(vitamin C)-log(50))*(RDW-13) to flexible additive conventional predictors changed external weighted log-CRP MSE from 1.082231 to 1.082391. Baseline-minus-augmented gain was -0.000159 (500 source-refit/target PSU bootstrap 95% interval -0.006109 to 0.001213). This representation has no established incremental predictive benefit; this is not evidence of equivalence or absence of vitamin-C biology. Development:4135 adults in2003–04;external cycle:4061 adults in2005–06. Source cross-validation also worsened. Participants are distinct public survey records,not different splits;the survey system and prior outcome exposure limit confirmation. AI-authored,self-checked,not independently peer reviewed.
